_readme: All text, prices, contact details and photos for the site. Edit here, then run `npm run build`. Guide: docs/EDITING.md. Anything containing XXX, example.com or 00 000 000 is a placeholder and is highlighted on the page until you replace it. FAQ answers with "confirm": true show a small 'draft' tag until you set it to false.

site._domain: Leave empty until the real domain is known, e.g. "https://apartmaji.matejdoljak.com" (no trailing slash). Filling it in turns on canonical, hreflang, og:url, sitemap.xml and the Sitemap line in robots.txt.

contact._note: PLACEHOLDERS. Replace all three with real values. Phone and WhatsApp in international format (+386 …).

prices._note: PLACEHOLDERS. Write the price exactly as it should appear, e.g. "€890" or "od €890".

calculator._note: Starting values for the commission calculator in the 'why' section. Visitors move the sliders; nothing is sent anywhere. ranges = [min, max, step].

images._note: src = source file in photos/. After changing a src, run `npm run images` and commit src/assets/img/. Alt text lives in i18n.<lang>.alt. Every image is replaceable. placeholder: true = illustrated stand-in drawn for this site; swap for a real photo when you have one. position = which part of the photo stays visible when it is cropped (CSS object-position).

items.a: Ne. Za domeno, gostovanje, izdelavo in objavo poskrbim jaz. Vi mi pošljete fotografije in odgovorite na nekaj vprašanj o nastanitvi.

items.q: Ali lahko obdržim Booking.com in Airbnb?
items.a: Seveda. Lastna stran platform ne nadomešča, ampak jih dopolni. Gostje, ki vas najdejo na Googlu ali se vračajo, vam lahko pišejo neposredno.
Povpraševanje prek strani ni samodejna rezervacija. Termin vedno potrdite vi, ko preverite svoj koledar — tako kot pri telefonskem klicu.
Vi. Domena se registrira na vaše ime, zato ostane vaša, tudi če kdaj zamenjate izvajalca.
Odvisno od obsega in od tega, kako hitro so pripravljene fotografije in besedila. Okvirni rok dobite v ponudbi.

items.q: V katerih jezikih je lahko stran?
items.a: Osnova sta slovenščina in angleščina. Dodamo lahko nemščino, italijanščino ali druge jezike, ki jih govorijo vaši gostje.

items.q: Kaj, če kasneje želim kaj spremeniti?
items.a: Spremembe besedil, cen ali fotografij uredim namesto vas. Kako in pod kakšnimi pogoji, zapišemo v ponudbo.

hero.kicker: Websites for holiday apartments and homes
hero.title: More guests who book {directly} with you.
hero.lead: A beautiful website of your own, a place on Google Maps and an easy way to ask for dates. So guests find you themselves — and message you without a middleman.

postcard.title: Welcome, directly.
items: Your own site, in your guests’ languages

why.kicker: Why a website of your own
why.title: On Booking.com you’re one of many. On your own site, you’re the only one.
why.body: Platforms are great for first guests. But if they’re the only way to reach you, every guest costs a commission — returning ones too.

points.title: A commission on every booking
points.body: Even a guest coming back for the third time goes through the platform. With your own site, they can write to you directly.

points.title: Hard to find on Google
points.body: When someone searches for an apartment in your town, they often see only platforms and neighbours. A proper Google Maps profile shows you too.

points.title: An old site turns guests away
points.body: A page that doesn’t fit a phone screen or takes too long to load gives guests no reason to stay.

points.title: Someone else makes the rules
points.body: You don’t decide on changes to algorithms, terms or commissions. Your own website is always yours.

why.calm: Booking.com and Airbnb can stay. Your own site is your second, direct front door.

services.title: Everything you need for guests to find you and get in touch.
services.intro: I take care of the technical side. You tell me what makes your place special.

items.title: A modern website
items.body: Beautiful, fast and built for phones first. In Slovenian, English and the languages your guests speak.

items.title: Google Maps & Business Profile
items.body: I set up or improve your profile: the right details, good photos and a link to your site. So people browsing the map find you too.

items.title: Direct inquiries
items.body: Guests pick their dates and number of people and send you a request. You check and confirm — no commission, no middleman.

items.title: Photos that sell the feeling
items.body: I show you what to photograph and how, so guests can feel the morning on your balcony before they arrive.

process.title: From the first call to the first guest.
process.intro: Four simple steps. Your main job is telling me about your place.

steps.title: A conversation
steps.body: Call or write. We talk about your place, your guests and what you’d like. You get a free proposal.

steps.title: Photos and content
steps.body: We choose the photos and prepare the texts together. You get a clear list of what I need — nothing technical.

steps.title: Building the site
steps.body: I build the site and show it to you. We refine it until it feels right.

steps.title: Live and on Google Maps
steps.body: The site goes live and your Google Maps profile links to it. Guests can now contact you directly.

items.q: Do I need any technical knowledge?
items.a: No. I take care of the domain, hosting, building and publishing. You send me photos and answer a few questions about your place.

items.q: Can I keep Booking.com and Airbnb?
items.a: Of course. Your own site doesn’t replace the platforms, it complements them. Guests who find you on Google or come back can write to you directly.

items.q: How do I avoid double bookings?
items.a: An inquiry through the site isn’t an automatic booking. You always confirm the dates yourself after checking your calendar — just like with a phone call.
You do. The domain is registered in your name, so it stays yours even if you ever change providers.
It depends on the scope and how quickly the photos and texts are ready. You get an estimated timeline in the proposal.

items.q: Which languages can the site have?
items.a: Slovenian and English as a base. We can add German, Italian or any other language your guests speak.

items.q: What if I want to change something later?
items.a: I update texts, prices or photos for you. How and on what terms is set out in the proposal.
